context: Asuka leads a seminar comparing two reports.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: seminar; analytical connectives (同様/直接/かつ/つて/求める) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 二つのレポートを、比べましょう。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一つ目は、直接的な表現が多いですね。
lines.en: The first has many direct expressions.
lines.style: analytical young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 直接かつ簡潔に、述べていますね。
lines.en: It states things directly and concisely.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 二つ目も、同様に明快ですか?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 同様に明快で、かつ丁寧です。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昔は、つてを頼って資料を集めたとか。
lines.en: In the past, they gathered data through connections, I hear.
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今は、つてに頼らず直接求められます。
lines.en: Now you can seek it directly, without connections.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 読み手が求めるものを、意識すべきですね。
lines.en: We should be mindful of what the reader seeks.
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm realization throughout
